verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requires current measurement on both the 3.3V and 5V rails, establishing the dual-rail metering behavior and its electrical contexts.
The client specifies the INA219 placement and total downstream measurement coverage for the 3.3V rail.
The client adopts a monitoring configuration that measures both rails with one spare channel; replacing the INA219-specific topology makes that prior top-level configuration stale.
The client requests omission of dedicated INA monitoring in favor of the AXP2101-based approach, making the prior dedicated monitor channel count obsolete.
